name: BlogWolf – AI Blog Post Generator & Auto-Pilot Content Writer
author: BlogWolf

sections.description:
BlogWolf is an AI blog post generator that creates SEO-optimized articles with images, directly from your WordPress dashboard. Write and publish blog posts in one click, or let auto-pilot mode generate and schedule content automatically.

Whether you run a WooCommerce store, a niche blog, or a content-driven website, BlogWolf helps you publish high-quality articles faster than ever.

AI Blog Post Generation

Generate complete, publish-ready blog posts using advanced AI models including Claude by Anthropic. Every article is structured with proper headings, internal flow, and natural language that reads like it was written by a professional content writer.

  • Choose from multiple AI models (Claude Sonnet, Haiku, Opus)
  • Set your preferred tone, language, and article length
  • Add target keywords for SEO-focused content
  • Generate articles in 20+ languages
  • Advanced SEO optimisation is standard

AI Image Generation

BlogWolf automatically generates featured images and inline images to accompany your articles. No need for stock photo subscriptions or manual image sourcing.

  • AI-generated featured images matched to your article topic
  • Inline images inserted throughout the article
  • SEO-optimized image metadata (alt text, titles, descriptions)
  • Multiple image styles and aspect ratios

Auto-Pilot Mode

Set it and forget it. Auto-pilot mode automatically generates and publishes blog posts on a schedule you define. Just choose the keywords you want to rank for and BlogWolf will do the rest. Build your content library in the background while you focus on running your business.

  • Schedule daily, weekly, or custom publishing intervals
  • Generate articles from your keyword lists automatically
  • Hands-free content publishing directly to WordPress
  • Full control over categories, tags, and post settings

WooCommerce Product Integration

Turn your WooCommerce product catalog into blog content. BlogWolf pulls in your products, categories, and attributes to generate product-focused articles that drive traffic and sales.

  • Automatically reference your WooCommerce products in articles
  • Link products directly within generated content
  • Support for product categories and taxonomies

Keyword Management

Organize your content strategy with built-in keyword management. Create keyword lists or let BlogWolf generate them for you. Track which keywords have been used in articles and prioritize high-value topics.

  • Create and organize keyword lists with tags
  • Assign value scores to prioritize important topics
  • Track which keywords have been written about
  • Feed keywords directly into auto-pilot for automated publishing
  • Let BlogWolf generate keywords for you

SEO-Optimized Content

Every article is generated with search engine optimization in mind. BlogWolf structures content with proper heading hierarchy, keyword placement, and readability for both users and search engines.

  • Proper H2/H3 heading structure
  • Natural keyword integration throughout the article
  • Meta-friendly titles and descriptions
  • Internal links inserted naturally into articles
  • External authority links inserted
  • Table of Contents
  • Author bios
  • Articles structure for LLMs (AI Search)
  • Image meta data
  • Yoast SEO integration
sections.installation:
1. In your WordPress admin, go to Plugins > Add New and search for “BlogWolf.”
  2. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate.”
  3. Click “BlogWolf” in your WordPress sidebar to get started.
  4. Create an account or log in to begin generating articles.
sections.faq:
How does AI blog post generation work?

BlogWolf uses advanced AI language models to generate complete blog posts based on your title, keywords, and preferences. You set the topic, tone, length, and language, and BlogWolf writes a full article with proper structure, headings, and natural-sounding content.

What AI models are available?

BlogWolf offers multiple AI models from Anthropic’s Claude family, including Claude Sonnet for balanced quality and speed, Claude Haiku for fast generation, and Claude Opus for the highest quality output.

Can I generate images with my articles?

Yes. BlogWolf includes AI image generation for both featured images and inline images within your articles. Images are generated to match your article topic and include SEO-optimized metadata like alt text and titles.

Does BlogWolf work with WooCommerce?

Yes. BlogWolf integrates directly with WooCommerce to pull in your products, categories, and attributes.

What is auto-pilot mode?

Auto-pilot mode lets you schedule automatic article generation and publishing. You set the schedule and choose a keyword list, and BlogWolf generates and publishes articles on autopilot without any manual intervention.

What languages are supported?

BlogWolf can generate articles in over 20 languages, including English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Dutch, and many more.

Do I need an account?

Yes, a free BlogWolf account is required to use the plugin. You can create one directly from the plugin settings page in your WordPress admin.

How does pricing work?

BlogWolf uses a credit-based system. Credits are used for generating articles and images. The cost per article depends on the AI model, article length, and options you choose. You get 50 free credits to test it out and experience the power of BlogWolf for yourself. You can purchase more credits directly from within the plugin. No subscription required.

Is my content unique?

Yes. Every article is generated fresh by the AI model based on your specific inputs. No content is recycled or spun from existing articles.

Can I edit articles before publishing?

Yes. Every generated article can be previewed and edited before publishing to your WordPress site. You have full control over the final content.
